probes.What is dental floss?:
Dental floss is a thin, flexible thread used to clean between teeth and under the gumline, removing plaque and food particles that a toothbrush can't reach. It helps prevent cavities, gum disease, and bad breath. There are different types, such as waxed, unwaxed, flavored, and dental tape, to suit various dental needs. probes.What are human teeth made of?:
Human teeth are made of several different materials, including enamel, dentin, cementum, and pulp. The outermost layer of the tooth is made of enamel, which is the hardest substance in the human body. Beneath the enamel is dentin, which makes up the majority of the tooth's structure. The root of the tooth is covered in cementum, which helps anchor the tooth to the jawbone. Inside the tooth is the pulp, which contains blood vessels and nerves. All of these materials work together to give teeth their strength and function.靈
